Headline: GE 2004 results: NDA loses
Context: 'India Shining' NDA lost unexpectedly; Left-backed UPA formed government. Fear of Left influence on reforms led to the 17-May 'Black Monday' crash with trading halted twice.

Headline: GE 2009 results: UPA wins without Left
Context: UPA won a stronger-than-expected mandate without needing Left support. On Monday 18-May the market hit the upper circuit twice and trading closed for the day.

Headline: GE 2014 results: BJP majority
Context: First single-party majority in 30 years. Exit polls had predicted an NDA win, so much of the rally happened before results; the size of the majority was a positive surprise.

Headline: GE 2019 results: NDA re-elected bigger
Context: NDA re-elected with a larger majority; largely priced in after the exit-poll rally of 20-May.

Headline: GE 2024 results: BJP short of majority
Context: Exit polls predicted a landslide; BJP won 240 seats and needed allies. Nifty fell sharply on results day and recovered within days once the NDA government was confirmed.

Headline: GE 2019 exit polls predict NDA win
Context: Exit polls released on Sunday 19-May predicted an NDA majority; big relief rally on Monday.

Headline: GE 2024 exit polls predict landslide
Context: Exit polls on 1-June predicted 350+ seats for NDA; record-high rally on Monday 3-June, reversed next day on actual results.

Headline: Gujarat 2007: BJP retains
Context: BJP retained Gujarat. Result declared on a Sunday; reaction on next trading day.

Headline: UP 2012: SP wins; Congress weak
Context: Samajwadi Party won UP; poor show by the ruling Congress raised concerns about reform momentum at the Centre.

Headline: Delhi/Raj/MP/Chh 2013: BJP wins 3 of 4
Context: Seen as a semi-final before GE 2014; BJP wins boosted 'Modi rally' expectations. Results on a Sunday.

Headline: Delhi 2015: AAP sweep
Context: AAP won 67 of 70 seats; BJP defeat seen as a dent to the central government's momentum.

Headline: Bihar 2015: BJP alliance loses
Context: Mahagathbandhan defeated the BJP-led alliance; concern about reform bills in Rajya Sabha. Results on a Sunday.

Headline: UP 2017: BJP landslide
Context: BJP won over 300 seats in UP; strengthened reform expectations. Results on Saturday; Monday was a Holi holiday.

Headline: Gujarat/HP 2017: BJP retains
Context: Early counting showed a close fight and the market fell sharply in the morning, then recovered as BJP pulled ahead.

Headline: Karnataka 2018: hung assembly
Context: BJP single largest but short of majority; Congress-JD(S) later formed the government.

Headline: MP/Raj/Chh 2018: BJP loses three states
Context: Congress won three Hindi-belt states; same week as RBI Governor Urjit Patel's resignation.

Headline: West Bengal 2021: TMC wins
Context: TMC retained Bengal against a strong BJP push; results on a Sunday during the COVID second wave.

Headline: UP 2022: BJP retains
Context: BJP retained UP, AAP won Punjab; policy continuity seen ahead of GE 2024.

Headline: Gujarat/HP 2022
Context: BJP won a record majority in Gujarat; Congress won Himachal Pradesh.

Headline: Karnataka 2023: Congress wins
Context: Congress won Karnataka with a clear majority. Results on a Saturday.

Headline: MP/Raj/Chh 2023: BJP sweep
Context: BJP won all three Hindi-belt states, more than expected; strong rally on Monday 4-Dec. Results on a Sunday.

Headline: Haryana 2024: BJP surprise win
Context: Exit polls predicted a Congress win; BJP won a third term.

Headline: Maharashtra 2024: Mahayuti landslide
Context: Ruling alliance won a large majority; strong rally on Monday 25-Nov. Results on a Saturday.

Headline: Delhi 2025: BJP wins
Context: BJP won Delhi after 27 years. Results on a Saturday.

Headline: Bihar 2025: NDA landslide
Context: NDA won a large majority in Bihar.

Headline: Global sell-off January 2008
Context: US recession fears; Sensex fell sharply on 21-Jan and hit the lower circuit on 22-Jan. Start of the 2008 bear market.

Headline: Lehman Brothers collapse
Context: Lehman filed for bankruptcy; global financial crisis intensified.

Headline: US Fed taper hint (taper tantrum)
Context: Bernanke hinted at tapering bond purchases on 22-May; FIIs pulled money from emerging markets; rupee crisis followed.

Headline: China Black Monday
Context: Yuan devaluation and Chinese market crash triggered a global sell-off.

Headline: Brexit referendum result
Context: UK voted to leave the EU.

Headline: IL&FS/DHFL crash
Context: IL&FS defaults and the DHFL intraday crash triggered an NBFC liquidity crisis.

Headline: COVID Black Thursday
Context: WHO declared a pandemic; Sensex fell about 8% in one day.

Headline: COVID lockdown crash
Context: Biggest single-day fall in Sensex history; national lockdown announced on 24-Mar. Near the market bottom.

Headline: Pfizer vaccine news
Context: Pfizer announced about 90% vaccine efficacy on 9-Nov (US time); strong global rally.

Headline: Russia invades Ukraine
Context: Brent above $100; sharp global sell-off.

Headline: Hindenburg report on Adani group
Context: Short-seller report triggered a crash in Adani group stocks and banks' exposure fears.

Headline: Yen carry-trade unwind
Context: Bank of Japan hike plus weak US jobs data led to a global crash on 5-Aug.

Headline: US 'Liberation Day' tariff crash
Context: US reciprocal tariffs announced on 2-Apr; global crash on Monday 7-Apr.

Headline: Surgical strikes across LoC
Context: Indian Army announced surgical strikes during market hours.

Headline: Balakot air strike
Context: Indian Air Force strike in Pakistan after the Pulwama attack.

Headline: Operation Sindoor
Context: Indian strikes on terror camps in Pakistan after the Pahalgam attack.

Headline: India-Pakistan ceasefire
Context: Ceasefire announced on 10-May; one of the biggest single-day rallies.

Headline: Demonetisation (and Trump win)
Context: Rs 500/1000 notes demonetised on the evening of 8-Nov; US election result on the same day.

Headline: Corporate tax cut
Context: Corporate tax rate cut to about 25%; biggest one-day rally in a decade.

Headline: GST rollout
Context: Goods and Services Tax launched at midnight on 1-Jul.

Headline: Gujral government falls
Context: Congress withdrew support from the United Front government; mid-term election followed.

Headline: Asian crisis: Hong Kong crash
Context: Hang Seng crashed on 23-Oct and Dow fell about 7% on 27-Oct during the Asian financial crisis.

Headline: GE 1998 results: hung parliament, BJP-led coalition
Context: No clear majority; Vajpayee formed a coalition government in March.

Headline: Pokhran-II nuclear tests
Context: India announced nuclear tests on 11-May; US and other countries imposed sanctions.

Headline: Union Budget 1998-99
Context: First budget of the Vajpayee government, presented under sanctions.

Headline: Russia default
Context: Russia devalued the rouble and defaulted on 17-Aug; LTCM hedge fund collapse followed in September.

Headline: Union Budget 1999-2000
Context: Union Budget FY2000.

Context: AIADMK withdrew support; the government lost the confidence vote 269-270. Result on a Saturday.

Headline: Kargil war: air strikes begin
Context: India launched air strikes against intruders in Kargil.

Headline: GE 1999 results: NDA wins
Context: NDA won a stable majority, ending the period of short-lived governments.

Headline: Union Budget 2000-01
Context: Budget at the peak of the dot-com boom; tax on dividends by mutual funds raised.

Headline: Dot-com crash: Nasdaq -10% on 14-Apr
Context: Nasdaq fell about 10% on Friday 14-Apr; technology stocks crashed worldwide.

Headline: Union Budget 2001-02
Context: Budget was well received, but the market crashed in March on the Ketan Parekh scandal.

Headline: Tehelka tapes and Ketan Parekh crash
Context: Defence-deal sting operation (Tehelka) shook the government while the Ketan Parekh price-rigging scandal caused a broker payment crisis.

Context: UTI froze redemptions in its US-64 scheme, hurting millions of small investors.

Context: Union Budget FY03.

Headline: Northern Rock bank run

Headline: Bear Stearns rescue

Headline: Lakshmi Vilas Bank moratorium

Headline: Silicon Valley Bank collapse
Context: SVB failed on 10-Mar; Signature Bank closed on 12-Mar.

Headline: Credit Suisse crisis
Context: Credit Suisse shares crashed; UBS took it over on 19-Mar.

Context: The Left parties withdrew support over the India-US nuclear deal.

Headline: UPA wins trust vote
Context: The government survived the confidence vote; markets rallied.

Context: Unfunded UK tax cuts (23-Sep) crashed the pound and gilts; Prime Minister Truss resigned weeks later.

Headline: Japan earthquake and Fukushima
Context: Earthquake and tsunami hit Japan during Indian market hours; nuclear disaster and supply-chain disruption followed.

Headline: India grid failure (biggest blackout in history)
Context: Northern grid failed on 30-Jul and three grids on 31-Jul, cutting power to over 600 million people.

Headline: Saudi Aramco drone attack
Context: Attack on Abqaiq on 14-Sep knocked out about half of Saudi output; Brent jumped about 15%.

Headline: Suez Canal blocked
Context: Container ship Ever Given blocked the Suez Canal for six days (23-29 Mar).

Context: Greek debt crisis and the 6-May US flash crash.

Headline: US credit rating downgrade
Context: S&P downgraded the US from AAA on 5-Aug; Euro crisis deepened.

Headline: China Evergrande crisis
Context: Fears of default by China's second-largest property developer.

Headline: Swine flu (H1N1) outbreak
Context: WHO raised the pandemic alert as H1N1 spread from Mexico; pandemic declared on 11-Jun.

Headline: Ebola reaches the US
Context: First Ebola case diagnosed in the US on 30-Sep during the West Africa outbreak.

Headline: COVID-19: human transmission confirmed
Context: China confirmed human-to-human transmission on 20-Jan; Wuhan lockdown on 23-Jan.

Headline: COVID-19 spreads to Italy
Context: Outbreaks in Italy and South Korea started the global crash.

Headline: India COVID second wave
Context: Daily cases crossed 1.5 lakh; lockdowns in Maharashtra and other states.

Headline: Omicron variant
Context: WHO flagged the new Omicron variant; global sell-off.
